answer: Agents bond stake, join a Semaphore-style identity tree, and evaluate an epoch polynomial to derive rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. A repeated message within the epoch exposes two valid shares at the same secret-derived point; Shamir reconstruction then reveals the private key, enabling verification and immediate slashing of the bonded collateral. The river of messages is bounded by the tide of each epoch, so a Sybil voyage demands distinct bonded identities rather than cheap duplicates.
